8.4.5 Dcm_TpTxConfirmation
[SWS_Dcm_00351] Definition of API function Dcm_TpTxConfirmation ⌈
Service Name
Dcm_TpTxConfirmation
Syntax
void Dcm_TpTxConfirmation (
PduIdType id,
Std_ReturnType result
)
Service ID [hex]
0x48
Sync/Async
Synchronous
▽
Manager
△
Reentrancy
Reentrant
id
Identification of the transmitted I-PDU.
Parameters (in)
result
E_OK: The I-PDU was transmitted successfully.
E_NOT_OK: Transmission of the I-PDU failed.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
This function is called after the I-PDU has been transmitted on its network, the result indicates
whether the transmission was successful or not. This function might be called in interrupt
context.
Available via
Dcm.h
